lines.l: Hey, you'd never put a pacifier in your mouth to clean it.
Never let them stay up too late.
And never let them run wild through the grocery store.
Clean up on aisle six.
And aisle three.
So when you say you'd never let them get into a car without you there,
no, it can happen.
One in four hot car deaths happen when a kid gets into an unlocked car
and can't get out.
Never happens.
Before you leave the car, always stop, look, lock.
Brought to you by NHTSA and the Ad Council.
I learned patience from my adoptive dad.
All he had to say was...
Hey, you got this. Just breathe.
Hey.
We're pretty good.
Yeah.
Might have to start a band.
I got it.
Learn about adopting a teen from foster care.
You can't imagine the reward.
Visit AdoptUSKids.org to find out more.
